# Agent Python Tools

- repo: huggingface/trl
- repo_uri: https://github.com/huggingface/trl.git

## File: huggingface_trl/trl/experimental/orpo/orpo_trainer.py

Prompts

```
['create an ORPOTrainer to fine-tune a causal language model with preference optimization without a reference model', 'build tokenized prompt and answer pairs with proper tokenizer handling for merged token edge cases', "compute ORPO's odds ratio loss from policy chosen and rejected log probabilities for preference optimization", 'run a concatenated forward pass on chosen and rejected inputs to avoid redundant forward computations', 'generate samples from the fine-tuned model using greedy or sampling decoding with prompt inputs']
```

Usage

```
{'create_ORPOTrainer': 'create an ORPOTrainer to fine-tune a causal language model with preference optimization without a reference model', 'build_tokenized_answer': 'build tokenized prompt and answer pairs with proper tokenizer handling for merged token edge cases', 'compute_odds_ratio_loss': "compute ORPO's odds ratio loss from policy chosen and rejected log probabilities for preference optimization", 'run_concatenated_forward': 'run a concatenated forward pass on chosen and rejected inputs to avoid redundant forward computations', 'generate_from_model': 'generate samples from the fine-tuned model using greedy or sampling decoding with prompt inputs'}
```
